new: Bregy’s own site says the Sunrise program is its after-school (Out-of-School Time) provider, Monday to Friday from 3:40 to 6:00 pm, and that families apply for a place. It has a listing here. Sunrise’s own list of its sites doesn’t name Bregy, so ask the school office how to apply.

The site also names its clubs and teams (Math 24, knitting, tutoring, safeties, lacrosse, football and intramurals) and its community partners (Community College of Philadelphia’s Jr. STEM Academy, UNICO, the Donatucci branch of the Free Library and PAWS). They are listed here as school clubs and partners. Its violin and band lessons are part of the school day.
Half days end at 12:39 pm. Ask Sunrise whether it runs on half days.
If you know a program that serves Bregy and isn’t here, send it in and it goes on this page.
